description: Migrate HTTP framework from Express to Hono with 1:1 translation, keeping all API behavior unchanged

tasks.title: Replace dependencies: remove express, add hono
tasks.description: Remove express and @types/express from package.json. Add hono and @hono/node-server as dependencies. Run npm install to update lock file.
acceptanceCriteria: express is not in package.json dependencies
tasks.notes: No @types/hono needed — hono ships its own types.

tasks.title: Migrate HttpServer class to Hono
tasks.description: Rewrite http-server.ts to use Hono instead of Express. Replace Express app with Hono instance, replace app.listen() with serve({ fetch, port }), replace app.use(path, router) with app.route(path, subApp). Keep the same public interface (addRouter, start, stop, getApp, getState).
acceptanceCriteria: HttpServer uses Hono instead of Express
addRouter uses app.route() to mount sub-applications
tasks.notes: serve() returns a Server instance — store it for stop(). Keep manual try/catch pattern, no onError middleware.

tasks.title: Migrate api/projects.ts to Hono
tasks.description: Convert projects.ts from Express Router to Hono. Replace Router() with new Hono(), replace (req, res) handlers with (c) handlers using c.req.json(), c.req.param(), c.json(). Keep all endpoints and error handling unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: createProjectRoutes returns Hono instance instead of Express Router
tasks.notes: Hono handlers are async by nature. Use c.req.json() for body, c.req.param('name') for params.

tasks.title: Migrate api/issues.ts to Hono
tasks.description: Convert issues.ts from Express Router to Hono. This is the largest API file (518 lines). Replace all (req, res) handlers with (c) handlers. Keep the activeAgentIssueId/activeAgentPromise module state unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: GET / lists issues with optional stage/label filtering
GET /:number returns issue details with comments
tasks.notes: Most mechanical: req.body → await c.req.json(), req.params.number → c.req.param('number'), res.json(x) → c.json(x), res.status(n).json(x) → c.json(x, n).

tasks.title: Migrate api/config.ts, api/status.ts, api/labels.ts to Hono
tasks.description: Convert the three smaller API files from Express Router to Hono. All follow the same pattern as T-003.
acceptanceCriteria: npm test api-routes.test.ts passes (status and config sections)
tasks.notes: These are straightforward translations. status.ts has duplicate /health endpoint with http-server.ts — keep as-is.

tasks.title: Update server/index.ts imports and wiring
tasks.description: Update server/index.ts to work with the new Hono-based modules. No logic changes — just ensure imports resolve and addRouter calls work with Hono sub-apps.
acceptanceCriteria: All createXxxRoutes calls work with Hono instances
tasks.notes: Minimal changes expected — the addRouter interface should remain compatible.

tasks.title: Update api-routes.test.ts to support Hono
tasks.description: Update tests/api-routes.test.ts supertest setup to work with Hono. Replace express() test app setup with Hono app creation. Ensure all test infrastructure works.
acceptanceCriteria: tests/api-routes.test.ts imports Hono instead of express for test app setup
Test setup creates Hono app with json middleware
All router tests use Hono instances
npm test passes for project routes
npm test passes for issue routes
npm test passes for status routes
npm test passes for config routes
tasks.notes: supertest works with any http.Server. Use @hono/node-server's createAdaptor or app.fetch directly. Test infrastructure must be ready before T-003~T-005.

tasks.title: Remove error-handler.ts and all Express imports
tasks.description: Remove error-handler.ts (currently unused — not wired into Express app). Search for any remaining Express imports across the codebase and remove them. Verify no Express references remain.
tasks.notes: error-handler.ts was defined but never used (no app.use(errorHandler)). Just remove it.
